dimensions.assessment: Applies nationwide to all educational institutions and individual veterans who utilized Post-9/11 educational assistance and carry school debts.
dimensions.evidence: An educational institution may not withhold the transcript of an individual who attended a course or program of education at such educational institution using educational assistance under this chapter solely because such individual owes a debt to such educational institution.

dimensions.assessment: Removes a major barrier for affected veterans trying to access employment or further education by forcing institutions to release transcripts regardless of unpaid debts.
dimensions.evidence: An educational institution may not withhold the transcript... solely because such individual owes a debt

dimensions.assessment: The source does not outline direct federal spending changes or revenue impacts, though it alters debt collection practices for schools.
Amends Title 38 of the United States Code to place a specific statutory restriction on educational institutions regarding transcript withholding.
dimensions.evidence: Subchapter III of chapter 33 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory prohibition on the practice of withholding transcripts for covered individuals.
dimensions.evidence: An educational institution may not withhold the transcript of an individual...

missing_information: The total number of veterans currently impacted by transcript withholding
The aggregate financial impact on educational institutions unable to collect debts via transcript withholding
importance_detail.rationale: The bill prohibits educational institutions from withholding transcripts from individuals who used Post-9/11 educational assistance solely because they owe a debt to the institution. This directly affects veterans with outstanding school debts seeking transcripts and alters collection practices for educational institutions participating in federal veteran education programs.
